# Pricing

`sales.obj.core.pricing` · v1.0.0 · **draft** · scope **core**

> What we will charge and how the charge is structured — level, packaging, term and discount policy. The discriminator against Proposal is durability: a proposal is one instance of a price offered to one buyer on one day, while pricing is the structure that instance is drawn from and the structure survives it. The structural choices — what is metered, what is committed, whether the renewal uplift is capped — outlast any single negotiation, are worth more than the discount everyone argues about, and are usually made carelessly under a deadline by whoever is still online.


Also called: `Commercial Terms`, `Price Structure`, `Quote Structure`

## Constraints

- **`pr.no_close_below_floor`** A deal cannot close while is_below_floor is true, whateverdiscount approval exists.
- **`pr.discount_needs_approver`** discount_bp above approval_required_above_bp requiresa named approver on the record.
- **`pr.one_live_quote`** Only one pricing structure may be in state quoted or under_negotiationper deal.
- **`pr.quote_within_approver_limit`** quoted_price above the buyer-side approver's limitrequires an escalation path before the quote is sent.
- **`pr.no_retroactive_structure_change`** pricing_model cannot change once state is lockedwithout restarting legal review.


## Business rules

- **`pr.no_discount_without_exchange`** A discount must be exchanged for something the buyer controls — term length, volume commitment, payment terms, a reference, a case study. An unreciprocated discount does not buy goodwill; it teaches the buyer that the next ask will also work, and there is always a next ask.

- **`pr.discount_above_policy_needs_named_approval`** A discount above approval_required_above_bp requires a named approver on the record before the number goes to the buyer, not after they accept it.
- **`pr.below_floor_blocks_close`** is_below_floor true blocks any close action regardless of discount approval. Policy and margin are different tests and clearing one does not clear the other.
- **`pr.multi_year_price_hold_is_an_approval`** price_increase_cap_bp = 0 across a term longer than twelve months requires the same approval as a discount of equivalent net present value. It is given away routinely because it costs nothing in the quarter it is granted.

- **`pr.metered_needs_a_minimum`** A usage-metered structure with no minimum_commitment transfers all volume risk to us and makes the account unforecastable from the day it signs.
- **`pr.quarter_end_reason_must_be_recorded`** Where the only reason for a discount is the calendar, discount_reason must be quarter_end. Recording it as competitive is what keeps a systemic discipline problem invisible.

## Actions

- **Issue a quote** (human) —
- **Change what is bought rather than what it costs** (human) — Move a tier or drop a module. Preserves the list relationship and the renewal, which a discount destroys.
- **Offer a ramped schedule** (human) — Buyers accept a materiallylarger total when part of it arrives later. Usually cheaper than the discount it replaces.
- **Trade term length for price** (human) — The one exchange both sides genuinely value. Only works if the uplift cap is held.
- **Escalate for discount approval** (human) — Beforethe number goes out. Escalating after the buyer has accepted converts an internal question into a public retraction.
- **Hold the price** (human) — The default and the least-takenoption. Most price objections are tested once and not repeated.


## Evidence

- **contract** · 10000 bp — Executed terms. The only record of what was actuallyagreed, and the only place the uplift cap exists.
- **document** · 9000 bp — The issued quote or order form. Line-item exactand dated.
- **email** · 7500 bp — Numbers written to the buyer, and their reply. Catchesthe concessions made outside the formal quote.
- **meeting_transcript** · 7000 bp — Buyer stating a ceiling or a competitornumber. Frequently a negotiating position rather than a fact.
- **crm** · 6500 bp — deal.value. Often the rep's expected value rather thanthe figure sent.
- **manual_entry** · 5000 bp — List price and policy typed in by hand whileno catalogue connector exists. Correct on the day it was entered.
- **derived** · 4000 bp — Sentiment around the commercial conversation. Corroboratingonly.


## Metrics

- **average_discount_bp** (basis_points) — Discount against list, by rep and bydeal shape. Uncomputable until a list price exists.
- **discount_without_exchange_rate** (percent) — Share of discounts granted withno reciprocal concession. The clearest measure of negotiation discipline and currently unmeasurable.
- **quarter_end_discount_share** (percent) — Discount volume in the final fortnightagainst the rest of the quarter. If this is high, the problem is the compensation plan, not the reps.
- **price_realisation** (percent) — Executed value against list. The number a boardshould ask for and rarely does.
- **renewal_uplift_achieved_bp** (basis_points) — Actual uplift at renewal againstthe cap conceded. Proves what a price hold really cost.
- **objection_to_close_rate** (percent) — Share of price objections that closewithout any discount. Usually far higher than reps believe.


## Examples

- **Per-seat annual, 10% off list, traded for a two-year term** — The clean case. A discountexchanged for something, inside policy, with the uplift cap held.
- **Fully metered usage pricing with no minimum commitment** — Reads as customer-friendlyand forecast-hostile. Next year's revenue is now a function of their business, and nobody agreed to that.
- **List price held, three-year price hold conceded instead** — THE classic misclassification.Booked as a full-price win, reported as zero discount, and worth more to the buyer than the 15% they originally asked for. price_increase_cap_bp = 0 is the whole story and nothing records it.
- **Price objection with no budget ever approved** — Handled as a negotiation and it isa sizing problem. Discounting here reduces the price towards a budget that does not exist.
- **Buyer accepts the first number without a word** — Celebrated in the deal review. Usuallymeans we priced under, and the only correct action is to raise the floor for the next one.

> Twelve patterns: seven executable, five needs_signal. The executable ones all read the buyer's side of the conversation, which the observation vocabulary covers well; every blocked one concerns our side, which it does not cover at all. The highest-value gap is the obs kind discount_granted — Layer 2 sees the buyer ask for a discount and never sees us agree, so the concession is invisible, pr.no_discount_without_exchange can never fire, and discount discipline is unmeasurable across the whole business. catalogue.list_price runs it close: without a list price, discount_bp is uncomputable and every discount rule in this file is decorative.
